summary: On macOS an Alt-modified key reaches a stui terminal tab's child with an Escape prefix only when it is a single ASCII character; an Option-composed character stays as text

replay.detail: No replay; no stored data or projection changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and fleet coordination are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: macOS only, stui terminal tabs: narrows the Escape prefix added for Alt by the previous change so a composed character such as an a with a ring that arrives with Alt set is delivered as the encoder wrote it. Linux is unchanged.

recovery.detail: Nothing is persisted; swapping to the previous binary needs no step.
